model_under_test: NCBI/GEO ESearch batch page-size reconstruction: len(esearchresult.idlist)

comparator_baseline.name: GEO total-hit-count page-size negative control
comparator_baseline.prediction_rule: use esearchresult.count as the retmax prediction for every batch row

uncertainty.method: deterministic NCBI/GEO ESearch batch replay with exact integer target

negative_controls.description: replace the page-size reconstruction with GEO total hit count and require a larger residual

falsifiers: retmax differs from returned idlist length, or the GEO total-count control is not worse
